headline: Osia Hyper Retail Limited: 5th CoC Meeting Notice under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process
sum: Osia Hyper Retail Limited is in active Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP); the NSE filing discloses prior intimation of the 5th Committee of Creditors meeting, indicating progression through multiple creditor resolution rounds.
implication: Multiple CoC rounds signal either contested resolution plans, failed proposals, or extended negotiation - practitioners should monitor for evidence of Plan approval, Plan amendment, or conversion to liquidation under IBC Sections 31–33, as the 5th meeting typically indicates substantive delay or Plan rejection cycles.
detail: Osia Hyper Retail Limited, a retail enterprise, is undergoing CIRP initiated under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. The disclosure on the NSE archives confirms that the 5th CoC meeting was called with prior public intimation - a procedural requirement under IBC 2016 and the IBBI (Insolvency Resolution Process for Corporate Persons) Regulations, 2016. The progression to a 5th CoC meeting suggests that earlier proposed resolution plans have not yet secured requisite approval (66% creditor voting threshold under IBC Section 30(4)), or that the process is navigating multiple rounds of Plan refinement or rejection.
